defects.description: The term “Resolution” should be translated as the required Russian equivalent “Резолюция”, but the translation uses “Разрешение”.
The glossary term “Role Status” is not translated; the heading remains in English.
The term “Finding” should be translated as the required Russian equivalent “Вывод”, but the translation uses “замечание”.
The term “Documenter” should be translated as the required Russian equivalent “Документатор”, but the translation uses “документа”.
